Definition: from G2274; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or (subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.
BiblicalUsage: hḗttēma means diminishing, fault. It turns up twice, in Romans and 1 Corinthians.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple here: hḗttēma means diminishing, fault, and I do not stretch it further.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
